target.statement: Post-merge median clustering success of 1.0 on FCPS Atom with k=20 (radius-based post-processing)

compute.basis: FCPS Atom is a tiny 2D dataset; k-means with k=20 and graph-based merging run in seconds on CPU, and the paper's code is available (though possibly incomplete).

title: Radius-Guided Post-Clustering for Shape-Aware, Scalable Refinement of k-Means Results
